title: Bridging Rural Inclusion for Dietary Guidance and Education (BRIDGE) Study
official: Bridging Rural Inclusion for Dietary Guidance and Education (BRIDGE) Study
summary: This study will test the acceptability and feasibility of the Wear-IT app for sending healthy eating messages and collecting questionnaires, photos, and videos via smart phone.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

In order to be enrolled, children must:

* Speak fluent English
* Be of good health based on parental self-report
* have no learning (e.g., dyslexia) or neurodevelopmental disabilities (e.g., ADHD)
* between the ages of 6-10 years-old at enrollment.
* Live in the Appalachian region of the United States.

Parents will be included if:

* Speak fluent English
* They report being the primary parent responsible for feeding decisions
* Have a smart-phone device that has an active phone service plan
* Live in the Appalachian region of the United States.

Exclusion criteria:

Children would be excluded if they:

* Do not speak fluent English
* are \<6 years old or \> 10 years-old at baseline
* have any of the following: a learning disability, ADD/ADHD, language delays, autism or other neurological or psychological conditions
* have a pre-existing medical condition such as type I or type II diabetes, rheumatoid arthritis, Cushing's syndrome, Down's syndrome, food allergies, severe lactose intolerance, Prader-Willi syndrome, HIV, cancer, renal failure, or cerebral palsy.
* Do not live in the Appalachian region of the United States.

Parents will be excluded if:

* Do not speak fluent English
* They report not being the primary parent responsible for feeding decisions
* Does not have a smart-phone device with an active phone service plan
* Do not live in the Appalachian region of the United States.

Secondary research subjects (other family members who may appear in video and consent to incidental recording): will be excluded if:

• They did not agree to have their identifiable images included in the home meal video
